programme.title: Keith Jarrett
programme.desc: Lugano Estival Jazz is an annual open-air music festival that takes place over five days at the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. On July 3, 1986, American pianist and composer Keith Jarrett is joined by bassist Gary Peacock and drummer Jack DeJohnette at Estival Jazz Lugano. Known as the Standards Trio, they put on an enthralling performance that shows these master musicians at their best.

programme.title: Christian McBride
programme.sub-title: Josh Evans - Ballad Of Ernie Washington
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn' at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, R&B, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical. Gracing the Malta Jazz stage with him are Nasheet Waits (drums), Marcus Strickland (tenor sax), and Josh Evans (trumpet).

programme.title: Larry Graham
programme.sub-title: Larry Graham: Ultimate Funk at the Bataclan
programme.desc: This recording brings a great performance by Larry Graham & Graham Central Station from Bataclan in Paris. Numerous ‘funkateers' came together to cheer the bass player and funk hero. In the sixties, Graham was mainly known for his work with Sly and the Family Stone, the popular and influential psychedelic soul and funk band. As founder and front man of Graham Central Station he has also enjoyed a successful solo career. It is often said that Graham pioneered the art of slap-pop playing on the electric bass, which has become a staple of modern funk. During this Paris performance, Graham shows he is one of the heroes of funk!

programme.title: Cannonball Adderley
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Tony Bennett
programme.desc: Relive the magic of one of the most beloved crooners in music history in his prime: Tony Bennett! Recorded live in London's Royal Albert Hall on March 2, 1974, this enchanting performance showcases Bennett's remarkable vocal prowess and charisma to full effect. Bennett is accompanied by his musical director Torrie Zito and an orchestra of British musicians that includes Kenny Clare (drums), Don Lusher (trombone), and Kenny Baker (trumpet). Tune in for Bennett's captivating take on songs “The Good Things in Life”, “My Favorite Things”, “My Love”, “I've Got Five Dollars”, “It Don't Mean a Thing”, and “Maybe This Time” in this magical concert recording.

programme.title: Louis Armstrong
programme.desc: Following a highly successful small-group jazz concert at New York Town Hall on May 17, 1947, Armstrong's manager Joe Glaser dissolved the Armstrong big band on August 13, 1947 and established a six-piece small group. This group was called the All Stars, and in 1964 Louis Armstrong recorded his biggest-selling record, Hello, Dolly! He made assorted television appearances, especially in the 1950s and 1960s – the recorded film was a TV Show in Australia when Armstrong was at the peak of his career. Armstrong kept up his busy tour schedule until a few years before his death in 1971. He also toured Africa, Europe, and Asia under sponsorship of the US State Department with great success, earning the nickname ‘Ambassador Satch'.

programme.title: Kenny Barron
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron's June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine's Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet). Their seamless blend of classic bebop and modern explorations spoke of a deep, emotive connection to each note, captivating the Ukrainian audience with lyrical improvisations during this unforgettable concert.

programme.title: Anita Oday, Göran Engdahl, Roman Dylag & John Poole
programme.desc: Anita O'Day boasts two wonderful concerts from 1963 and 1970 that present the “jazz singer supreme” in impeccable form. O'Day's horn-based approach to singing is in full effect throughout both shows including stand-out renditions in each show of audience favorites “Tea For Two” and “Sweet Georgia Brown” (both reprised from her triumphant appearance at the 1958 Newport Jazz Festival.) This show is a fitting testimony to one of jazz music's true originals and shows unequivocally why she is ranked in the top tier of vocalists along with Ella Fitzgerald, Sarah Vaughan, and Billie Holiday.

programme.title: Lalah Hathaway
programme.desc: Winner of five Grammys in four consecutive years, including the Grammy for best R&B album in 2017, Lalah Hathaway is a force impossible to ignore. The American artist has shared the scene with Prince, Snoop Dogg, Stevie Wonder, Anita Baker, Mary J. Blige, Frank Ocean and many others, an irrefutable proof of her keen musical sense and enormous talent. With a 26-year career, Hathaway is still highly sought after by the biggest names in music. See her transform the 2018 Sing Jazz festival scene into a real R&B club, where she flaunts her voice and stage presence out of the ordinary.

programme.title: Miriam Makeba, J.K. Naimro, Stanley Todd & Al Sanders
programme.sub-title: Miriam Makeba Live at Estival Lugano 1985
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Miriam Makeba, also named Mama Africa, was a South African singer, actress, United Nations goodwill ambassador, and civil-rights activist. Her career flourished in the US, where she released several albums. Makeba was among the first African musicians to receive worldwide recognition. She brought African music to a Western audience, and popularized the world music and Afropop genres. Her performances at Estival Lugano is beyond incredible. Her voice, the power and the soul summarizes her musicality in 40 minutes, together with her band and extremely talented backing-vocals.

programme.title: Kenny Barron
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron's June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine's Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet). Their seamless blend of classic bebop and modern explorations spoke of a deep, emotive connection to each note, captivating the Ukrainian audience with lyrical improvisations during this unforgettable concert.

programme.title: Václav Luks & Collegium 1704
programme.desc: J. S. Bach's six Brandenburg Concerto's belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces' 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021. The concertos are based on the Italian concerto grosso form, in which a group of solo instruments is set against a large ensemble. Bach's Brandenburg Concertos feature remarkable combinations of solo instruments and virtuoso solos. This performance was recorded at the Hall of Mirrors in the Köthen Castle, Germany.

programme.title: Antoine Tamistit & Robin Ticciati
programme.sub-title: Walton's Viola Concerto & Brahms's Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: British conductor Robin Ticciati conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a performance of William Walton's Viola Concerto and Johannes Brahms's Symphony No. 4 in E minor, Op. 98. When the young Walton premiered his Viola Concerto in 1927, it caused a Europe-wide sensation: a composer in his twenties, taking a neglected instrument and writing for it with unprecedented imagination and power. Viola virtuoso Antoine Tamestit features as the soloist in this Concerto. Brahms's Symphony No. 4 would be the composer's last – but every note burns with creative fire. This concert, which unites youthful genius with music drawn from a profound engagement with life, was recorded at LSO St. Luke's on Old Street in London, UK, on October 14, 2021.

programme.title: Stephanie Childress, Alina Ibragimova & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.desc: Stephanie Childress conducts the London Symphony Orchestra and Sibelius and Mendelssohn provide the soundtrack for this unique concert with a distinctly Northern European flavor, live from London's LSO St Luke's. The evening begins with Jean Sibelius's En Saga, a symphonic poem that, like its composer, has become a defining figure of Finnish national musical identity. On the other side of the Baltic, it took Mendelssohn six years to complete his famed Violin Concerto—and it was well worth the wait, as violin virtuoso Alina Ibragimova's powerhouse rendition will demonstrate! The concert ends in style with two short works from Finland: Lumière et pesanteur by the fabulous Kaija Saariaho—ranked the world's greatest living composer by BBC Music Magazine—and another work by the endlessly inventive Sibelius, the spirited and episodic Cassazione.

programme.title: Ryan Wiglesworth & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.desc: Ryan Wiglesworth conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance of W. A. Mozart's Symphony No. 41 'Jupiter', K. 551. It is the longest and last symphony Mozart composed. It is the last of three symphonies Mozart composed during the summer of 1788. It follows the traditional symphonic form in four movements. Unlike Symphony No. 39, the work has no intro but instead a grand finale. Recorded at St. Luke's on November 11, 2020.

programme.title: Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Fabio Luisi, Copenhagen Royal Chapel Choir & MDR Leipzig Radio Choir
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Gustav Mahler's Symphony No. 8. The work is one of the largest-scale choral works in the classical concert repertoire and is frequently called the "Symphony of a Thousand." The work was composed at Mahler's Maiernigg villa in southern Austria in the summer of 1906 and is the last work which was premiered in Mahler's lifetime. Soloists include Ricarda Merbeth (soprano), Henriette Bonde-Hansen (soprano), Sofia Fomini (soprano), Marianne Beate Kielland (alto), Olesya Petrova (alto), Stefan Vinke (tenor), Russel Braun (baritone), and Günther Groissböck (bass). Among the participating choirs are the Danish National Concert Choir, MDR Leipzig Radio Choir and Copenhagen Royal Chapel Choir. Recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in 2017.

programme.title: George Thorogood & the Destroyers
programme.desc: George Thorogood is an American icon. In a career that stretches back to the mid-seventies, he and his band The Destroyers have released 16 studio albums with worldwide sales in excess of 15 million. 2013 saw George & The Destroyers make their long overdue debut at the legendary Montreux Jazz Festival. Performing at an event that had previously played host to many of their musical heroes inspired the band to produce one of their finest performances on a set list that stretched back to their eponymous debut album from 1977 and right up to their most recent releases. This is goodtime rocking blues and nobody does it better than George Thorogood & The Destroyers.

programme.title: Evanescence
programme.desc: In 2003, Evanescence released Fallen, one of the most decade-defining albums (and one of the most successful debut albums of all time) and have gone on to became one of the most well-loved & respected bands of their generation. In the 15 years since their debut, Evanescence founder and lead-singer, Amy Lee, toured the world, has scored motion picture films and even took a 3 year break to start a family. In late 2017, Evanescence re-emerged from their hiatus with Synthesis—a reimagining of their best-known songs with orchestra & electronics and an accompanying sold-out and highly-acclaimed world tour. On November 3, 2017 Evanescence performed “Synthesis Live” in front of a sold out crowd at the Grand Theater at Foxwoods Casino in CT.

programme.title: Flying Over Iceland II
programme.desc: Experience the wonders of summertime in Iceland from an elevated perspective with "Flying Over Iceland II: Summer in the Golden Circle". Filmed during quarantine in September of 2020, ambient film features an immersive slow-moving aerial perspective of some of Islandia's most iconic and famous south coast loop locations - all in glorious sunlight. Beginning at the stunning 200 foot high Skogafoss waterfall, viewers next are gently flown to the charming coastal city of Vik, which overlooks the famous Vikurfjara Black Sand Beach. Here ancient lava flows have sculpted some impressive coastal outcroppings which viewers will witness from a bird's eye view, before soaring to great heights in order to witness the distant glaciers and unique geography of South Iceland as never seen before. From the black sand beach we then soar west to the charming Dyrholaey Lighthouse, which also sits atop some absolutely stunning coastal rock formations including a giant arch at sea level. After returning to Vik the film next progresses to the glacier Vatnajökull, offering majestic views of Iceland's largest glacier. From soaring above the misty clouds to dipping down into the ice formations, the film ends with multiple unique perspectives of the glacial area including young pine forests, a visit from some local sheep, and a journey above and below the clouds for one final refreshing cap to the 1 hour film.

programme.title: Onegin
programme.desc: Russia, 1820s: Onegin inherits his uncle's country estate and moves there from St. Petersburg. He befriends his neighbor, Lensky, and meets Tatyana through him. She falls in love with Onegin but he just wants friendship. Contains some violent scenes.

programme.title: Dark Night of the Scarecrow

programme.title: JFK

programme.title: Memoirs Of An Invisible Man
programme.desc: When a government experiment goes awry it renders an innocent bystander invisible.

programme.title: Into The Blue
programme.desc: Young vacationers, expecting to have a memorable time diving, find themselves in deep trouble with a druglord when they come upon the illicit cargo of a sunken airplane.

programme.title: The Big Wedding
programme.desc: A modern family tries to survive a weekend wedding celebration that has the potential to become a full-blown fiasco in this uproarious romantic comedy with an all-star cast.

programme.title: Taking Sides
programme.desc: After the end of World War II, a famous German conductor is accused of loyalty to the Nazi regime. He argues that art and politics are separate. An investigator thinks otherwise.

programme.title: The Divergent Series: Allegiant
programme.desc: ALLEGIANT takes Tris and Four into a new world, far more dangerous than ever before.

programme.title: Halloween
programme.desc: Michael Myers is released from a mental institution, and goes on a rampage to find his younger sister.

programme.title: Halloween II
programme.desc: While Dr. Loomis hunts for Michael Myers, a traumatized Laurie is rushed to Haddonfield Memorial Hospital.

programme.title: House of 1000 Corpses
programme.desc: Two couples traveling across Texas end up as prisoners of a sadistic backwater family of serial killers.

programme.title: Pandorum
programme.desc: Two astronauts (Dennis Quaid, Vantage Point and Ben Foster, 30 Days of Night) awaken in a hyper-sleep chamber aboard a seemingly abandoned spacecraft. It's pitch black, they are disoriented, and the only sound is a low rumble and creak from the belly of the ship. They can't remember anything like who they are and what their mission is, but one thing they do realise very quickly is that they are not alone. Slowly the spacecraft's shocking, deadly secrets are revealed and the astronauts find that they must fight to stay alive and that their survival is more important than they could ever have imagined. Directed by Christian Alvart and also starring Cam Gigandet (Twilight), Cung Le (Tekken) and newcomer Antje Traue.

programme.title: Adventures of a Plumber's Mate
programme.desc: Times are hard for plumber Sid South. Up to his neck in bills, facing eviction from his home and in debt to a violent bookie, he desperately needs to raise some funds or else Sid will be a broken man - literally, as there are two thugs ready to break every bone in his body unless he hands over the cash he owes their boss. It doesn't help that Sid never seems to get paid for any of the work he does, as his occupation lands him in a variety of risqu situations which always end in disaster. Drastic times call for drastic measures, and the browbeaten plumber seeks employment from Dodger, a shady wheeler-dealer who can put some dubious work Sid's way. But, as always, things never seem to go exactly to plan and the beguiled plumber finds himself in further strife.

programme.title: Adventures of a Taxi Driver
programme.desc: Joe likes the ladies and gets to meet a variety of them in his job as a taxi driver. From dizzy young women to frustrated housewives, Joe fancies them all, and they take a fancy to Joe. If only things were smoother at home for the put-upon cabbie. With his nagging mother, thieving teenage brother, and the attentions of an overbearing girlfriend with ideas of marriage, Joe leaves the homestead and rents the spare room at his best mate's flat. Meanwhile, he continues to find himself in an assortment of humorous sexual escapades until he accidentally becomes embroiled in a jewel heist that doesn't quite go to plan.

programme.title: It Follows
programme.desc: For 19-year-old Jay (Maika Monroe), the fall should be about school, boys and weekends out at the lake. But after a seemingly innocent sexual encounter, she finds herself plagued by strange visions and the inescapable sense that someone, or something, is following her. Faced with this burden, Jay and her teenage friends must find a way to escape the horrors that seem to be only a few steps behind.

programme.title: Betrayed
programme.desc: Based on shocking true events. In November 1942 hundreds of Jewish citizens in Norway were taken from their homes. Men, women and children forced on to a ship headed for Oslo, with the destination set to be where the industrialisation of human suffering became a horrifying reality - Auschwitz. Follow one family's struggle as the life they knew and loved is ripped from them by the tides of war.

programme.title: Gatlopp: Hell of a Game
programme.desc: Jumanji meets Escape Room. Its going to be one hell of a game. Four friends reunite for game night to forget the trauma of adult life. With mischief, booze and mayhem on the cards, are they playing the game or is the game playing them? With their lives on the line, the group must face their inner demons by the time the sun rises or be forced to play the game for eternity.

programme.title: Hitman Redemption
programme.desc: The executive producer of Mudbound brings you this slick, gun-toting neo-noir thriller. Asher (Ron Perlman: Hellboy), a former Mossad agent turned gun for hire, lives an austere life in an ever-changing Brooklyn. He breaks the oath he took as a young man upon meeting Sophie (Famke Janssen: X-Men) on a hit gone wrong. For love, he must kill the man he was, to become the man he wants to be.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In London
programme.desc: The epic rise and fall of a nationwide criminal empire that lasted for three decades and paved the way for the notorious Kray twins to exert their dominance over the capital.

programme.title: Terror on the Prairie
programme.desc: True Grit meets The Handmaid's Tale in this highly-unsettling and ruthlessly vicious female-led western thriller. On the Montana plains, a frontier woman must protect herself against a ruthless gang of outlaws hell-bent on revenge. Starring Gina Carano (The Mandalorian), Samaire Armstrong (The O.C), Nick Searcy (The Shape of Water), and Gabriel-Kane Day Lewis (Daniel Day Lewis' son).

programme.title: Grace and Grit

programme.title: Motherland

programme.title: Close to You

programme.title: Holiday Date

programme.title: Keith Jarrett
programme.desc: Lugano Estival Jazz is an annual open-air music festival that takes place over five days at the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. On July 3, 1986, American pianist and composer Keith Jarrett is joined by bassist Gary Peacock and drummer Jack DeJohnette at Estival Jazz Lugano. Known as the Standards Trio, they put on an enthralling performance that shows these master musicians at their best.

programme.title: Christian McBride
programme.sub-title: Josh Evans - Ballad Of Ernie Washington
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn' at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, R&B, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical. Gracing the Malta Jazz stage with him are Nasheet Waits (drums), Marcus Strickland (tenor sax), and Josh Evans (trumpet).

programme.title: Larry Graham
programme.sub-title: Larry Graham: Ultimate Funk at the Bataclan
programme.desc: This recording brings a great performance by Larry Graham & Graham Central Station from Bataclan in Paris. Numerous ‘funkateers' came together to cheer the bass player and funk hero. In the sixties, Graham was mainly known for his work with Sly and the Family Stone, the popular and influential psychedelic soul and funk band. As founder and front man of Graham Central Station he has also enjoyed a successful solo career. It is often said that Graham pioneered the art of slap-pop playing on the electric bass, which has become a staple of modern funk. During this Paris performance, Graham shows he is one of the heroes of funk!

programme.title: Cannonball Adderley
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Tony Bennett
programme.desc: Relive the magic of one of the most beloved crooners in music history in his prime: Tony Bennett! Recorded live in London's Royal Albert Hall on March 2, 1974, this enchanting performance showcases Bennett's remarkable vocal prowess and charisma to full effect. Bennett is accompanied by his musical director Torrie Zito and an orchestra of British musicians that includes Kenny Clare (drums), Don Lusher (trombone), and Kenny Baker (trumpet). Tune in for Bennett's captivating take on songs “The Good Things in Life”, “My Favorite Things”, “My Love”, “I've Got Five Dollars”, “It Don't Mean a Thing”, and “Maybe This Time” in this magical concert recording.

programme.title: Louis Armstrong
programme.desc: Following a highly successful small-group jazz concert at New York Town Hall on May 17, 1947, Armstrong's manager Joe Glaser dissolved the Armstrong big band on August 13, 1947 and established a six-piece small group. This group was called the All Stars, and in 1964 Louis Armstrong recorded his biggest-selling record, Hello, Dolly! He made assorted television appearances, especially in the 1950s and 1960s – the recorded film was a TV Show in Australia when Armstrong was at the peak of his career. Armstrong kept up his busy tour schedule until a few years before his death in 1971. He also toured Africa, Europe, and Asia under sponsorship of the US State Department with great success, earning the nickname ‘Ambassador Satch'.

programme.title: Kenny Barron
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron's June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine's Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet). Their seamless blend of classic bebop and modern explorations spoke of a deep, emotive connection to each note, captivating the Ukrainian audience with lyrical improvisations during this unforgettable concert.

programme.title: Anita Oday, Göran Engdahl, Roman Dylag & John Poole
programme.desc: Anita O'Day boasts two wonderful concerts from 1963 and 1970 that present the “jazz singer supreme” in impeccable form. O'Day's horn-based approach to singing is in full effect throughout both shows including stand-out renditions in each show of audience favorites “Tea For Two” and “Sweet Georgia Brown” (both reprised from her triumphant appearance at the 1958 Newport Jazz Festival.) This show is a fitting testimony to one of jazz music's true originals and shows unequivocally why she is ranked in the top tier of vocalists along with Ella Fitzgerald, Sarah Vaughan, and Billie Holiday.

programme.title: Lalah Hathaway
programme.desc: Winner of five Grammys in four consecutive years, including the Grammy for best R&B album in 2017, Lalah Hathaway is a force impossible to ignore. The American artist has shared the scene with Prince, Snoop Dogg, Stevie Wonder, Anita Baker, Mary J. Blige, Frank Ocean and many others, an irrefutable proof of her keen musical sense and enormous talent. With a 26-year career, Hathaway is still highly sought after by the biggest names in music. See her transform the 2018 Sing Jazz festival scene into a real R&B club, where she flaunts her voice and stage presence out of the ordinary.

programme.title: Miriam Makeba, J.K. Naimro, Stanley Todd & Al Sanders
programme.sub-title: Miriam Makeba Live at Estival Lugano 1985
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Miriam Makeba, also named Mama Africa, was a South African singer, actress, United Nations goodwill ambassador, and civil-rights activist. Her career flourished in the US, where she released several albums. Makeba was among the first African musicians to receive worldwide recognition. She brought African music to a Western audience, and popularized the world music and Afropop genres. Her performances at Estival Lugano is beyond incredible. Her voice, the power and the soul summarizes her musicality in 40 minutes, together with her band and extremely talented backing-vocals.

programme.title: Kenny Barron
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron's June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine's Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet). Their seamless blend of classic bebop and modern explorations spoke of a deep, emotive connection to each note, captivating the Ukrainian audience with lyrical improvisations during this unforgettable concert.

programme.title: Václav Luks & Collegium 1704
programme.desc: J. S. Bach's six Brandenburg Concerto's belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces' 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021. The concertos are based on the Italian concerto grosso form, in which a group of solo instruments is set against a large ensemble. Bach's Brandenburg Concertos feature remarkable combinations of solo instruments and virtuoso solos. This performance was recorded at the Hall of Mirrors in the Köthen Castle, Germany.

programme.title: Antoine Tamistit & Robin Ticciati
programme.sub-title: Walton's Viola Concerto & Brahms's Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: British conductor Robin Ticciati conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a performance of William Walton's Viola Concerto and Johannes Brahms's Symphony No. 4 in E minor, Op. 98. When the young Walton premiered his Viola Concerto in 1927, it caused a Europe-wide sensation: a composer in his twenties, taking a neglected instrument and writing for it with unprecedented imagination and power. Viola virtuoso Antoine Tamestit features as the soloist in this Concerto. Brahms's Symphony No. 4 would be the composer's last – but every note burns with creative fire. This concert, which unites youthful genius with music drawn from a profound engagement with life, was recorded at LSO St. Luke's on Old Street in London, UK, on October 14, 2021.

programme.title: Stephanie Childress, Alina Ibragimova & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.desc: Stephanie Childress conducts the London Symphony Orchestra and Sibelius and Mendelssohn provide the soundtrack for this unique concert with a distinctly Northern European flavor, live from London's LSO St Luke's. The evening begins with Jean Sibelius's En Saga, a symphonic poem that, like its composer, has become a defining figure of Finnish national musical identity. On the other side of the Baltic, it took Mendelssohn six years to complete his famed Violin Concerto—and it was well worth the wait, as violin virtuoso Alina Ibragimova's powerhouse rendition will demonstrate! The concert ends in style with two short works from Finland: Lumière et pesanteur by the fabulous Kaija Saariaho—ranked the world's greatest living composer by BBC Music Magazine—and another work by the endlessly inventive Sibelius, the spirited and episodic Cassazione.

programme.title: Ryan Wiglesworth & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.desc: Ryan Wiglesworth conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance of W. A. Mozart's Symphony No. 41 'Jupiter', K. 551. It is the longest and last symphony Mozart composed. It is the last of three symphonies Mozart composed during the summer of 1788. It follows the traditional symphonic form in four movements. Unlike Symphony No. 39, the work has no intro but instead a grand finale. Recorded at St. Luke's on November 11, 2020.

programme.title: Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Fabio Luisi, Copenhagen Royal Chapel Choir & MDR Leipzig Radio Choir
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Gustav Mahler's Symphony No. 8. The work is one of the largest-scale choral works in the classical concert repertoire and is frequently called the "Symphony of a Thousand." The work was composed at Mahler's Maiernigg villa in southern Austria in the summer of 1906 and is the last work which was premiered in Mahler's lifetime. Soloists include Ricarda Merbeth (soprano), Henriette Bonde-Hansen (soprano), Sofia Fomini (soprano), Marianne Beate Kielland (alto), Olesya Petrova (alto), Stefan Vinke (tenor), Russel Braun (baritone), and Günther Groissböck (bass). Among the participating choirs are the Danish National Concert Choir, MDR Leipzig Radio Choir and Copenhagen Royal Chapel Choir. Recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in 2017.

programme.title: George Thorogood & the Destroyers
programme.desc: George Thorogood is an American icon. In a career that stretches back to the mid-seventies, he and his band The Destroyers have released 16 studio albums with worldwide sales in excess of 15 million. 2013 saw George & The Destroyers make their long overdue debut at the legendary Montreux Jazz Festival. Performing at an event that had previously played host to many of their musical heroes inspired the band to produce one of their finest performances on a set list that stretched back to their eponymous debut album from 1977 and right up to their most recent releases. This is goodtime rocking blues and nobody does it better than George Thorogood & The Destroyers.

programme.title: David Gilmour
programme.desc: David Gilmour - Remember That Night: Live at the Royal Albert Hall is recorded by guitarist David Gilmour where he presents live tracks from the album On an Island and some hits from his former band Pink Floyd.

programme.title: Evanescence
programme.desc: In 2003, Evanescence released Fallen, one of the most decade-defining albums (and one of the most successful debut albums of all time) and have gone on to became one of the most well-loved & respected bands of their generation. In the 15 years since their debut, Evanescence founder and lead-singer, Amy Lee, toured the world, has scored motion picture films and even took a 3 year break to start a family. In late 2017, Evanescence re-emerged from their hiatus with Synthesis—a reimagining of their best-known songs with orchestra & electronics and an accompanying sold-out and highly-acclaimed world tour. On November 3, 2017 Evanescence performed “Synthesis Live” in front of a sold out crowd at the Grand Theater at Foxwoods Casino in CT.

programme.title: Flying Over Iceland II
programme.desc: Experience the wonders of summertime in Iceland from an elevated perspective with "Flying Over Iceland II: Summer in the Golden Circle". Filmed during quarantine in September of 2020, ambient film features an immersive slow-moving aerial perspective of some of Islandia's most iconic and famous south coast loop locations - all in glorious sunlight. Beginning at the stunning 200 foot high Skogafoss waterfall, viewers next are gently flown to the charming coastal city of Vik, which overlooks the famous Vikurfjara Black Sand Beach. Here ancient lava flows have sculpted some impressive coastal outcroppings which viewers will witness from a bird's eye view, before soaring to great heights in order to witness the distant glaciers and unique geography of South Iceland as never seen before. From the black sand beach we then soar west to the charming Dyrholaey Lighthouse, which also sits atop some absolutely stunning coastal rock formations including a giant arch at sea level. After returning to Vik the film next progresses to the glacier Vatnajökull, offering majestic views of Iceland's largest glacier. From soaring above the misty clouds to dipping down into the ice formations, the film ends with multiple unique perspectives of the glacial area including young pine forests, a visit from some local sheep, and a journey above and below the clouds for one final refreshing cap to the 1 hour film.

Además de dirigir la lavandería, Omar y Johnny reanudan la amistad que los unía cuando eran estudiantes. Su relación de amantes profundamente enamorados escandaliza a sus respectivas familias.

programme.title: Melancolía
programme.desc: Con motivo de su matrimonio, Justine y Michael dan una suntuosa recepción en la casa de la hermana de Justine y de su cuñado. Mientras tanto, el planeta Melancholia se dirige hacia la Tierra.

programme.title: La verdad puede matar
programme.desc: Un conductor de confianza debe lidiar con la amante musulmana de su jefe fallecido, cuyo oscuro pasado lo arrastra a un enfrentamiento a vida o muerte con su famoso primo gánster y exmarido.

programme.title: El poder de un sueño
programme.desc: Drunkboat cuenta la historia de un joven adolescente, Abe, que manipula a su desprevenido tío alcohólico (Malkovich) para que compre un bote a un estafador (Goodman).

programme.title: Siempre Alice
programme.desc: Ganadora del Oscar a Mejor Actriz (Julianne Moore), 2014. La doctora Alice Howland es una profesora casada y madre de 3 hijos, no da importancia a los pequeños lapsus hasta que debe comenzar a luchar para seguir siendo Alice.

programme.title: Los Mercenarios
programme.desc: Un veterano de guerra ha reunido a un grupo de mercenarios de élite para operaciones puntuales de rescate.

programme.title: El virginiano
programme.desc: “El Virginiano”, trabaja como capataz y defiende la brutal realidad que impera el “código del Oeste”.

programme.title: Mentiras e ilusiones
programme.desc: Un novelista del género policiaco y de espionaje es perseguido por un espía basándose en sus novelas.

programme.title: Abanderados
programme.desc: Un documental sobre leyendas olímpicas

programme.title: Mis Dos Amores
programme.desc: Un soltero que regresa al piso de sus padres, empieza a salir con una joven y el matrimonio parece cercano.

programme.title: Siempre a tu lado. Hachiko
programme.desc: Basada en hechos reales, la película sigue la leal amistad entre un profesor y su perro Akita. Hachi espera en la estación, incluso cuando su dueño ya no regresa.

programme.title: Sin escapatoria
programme.desc: Bajo las órdenes de un despiadado jefe mafioso, un conductor que se da a la fuga después de un violento atraco deberá entregar a un joven miembro de la banda en una emboscada para ejecutarlo.

programme.title: Otra vuelta de tuerca
programme.desc: Durante más de cien años, una historia profundamente inquietante se ha ido transmitiendo para aterrorizar al público.

programme.title: La posesión de Mary
programme.desc: David (Gary Oldman) es un humilde, luchador y experto marino que busca una vida mejor para su familia – su mujer, Sarah (Emily Mortiner) y sus dos hijas, la adolescente Lindsey (Stefanie Scott) y la pequeña Mary (Chloe Perrin).

programme.title: Libertad
programme.desc: Basada en una historia real. Dos hombres separados por 100 años están unidos en su búsqueda hacia la libertad. En 1856, un esclavo, Samuel Woodward y su familia, escapan de la plantación Monroe cerca de Virginia.

programme.title: Marmalade
programme.desc: Historia romántica teñida de crimen que te mantiene al borde del asiento. Baron (Joe Keery), recientemente encarcelado, entabla amistad con su compañero de celda Otis (Aldis Hodge), un hombre con un amplio historial de fugas de prisión.

programme.title: Monos
programme.desc: En la cima de una imponente montaña, donde lo que a primera vista parece un campamento de verano, ocho niños guerrilleros apodados “Los Monos» conviven bajo la atenta mirada de un sargento paramilitar. Su única misión es clara: cuidar a la doctora, una americana a la que han tomado como rehén.

programme.title: La ola
programme.desc: Excelente y multipremiada cinta basada en hechos reales sobre la escalofriante historia de un profesor que, para explicar los regímenes autoritarios, idea un expermiento consistente en implantar un régimen de extrema disciplina militar en el aula. El experimento se convertirá en una pesadilla.

programme.title: Amor a Primera Visa
programme.desc: Tras su fiesta de despedida, despierta en el apartamento de un apuesto mariachi y padre soltero.

programme.title: Lejos de la tierra quemada
programme.desc: Ópera prima de Guillermo Arriaga como director. Cuatro intensas historias en torno al amor.

programme.title: El Puente de San Luis Rey
programme.desc: Cuando el puente de San Luis se derrumba, los viajeros caen al abismo.

programme.title: Novia por conveniencia
programme.desc: Una novia rusa que quiere conseguir el permiso de residencia es encargada por correo.

programme.title: Navidades en incógnito
programme.desc: En Navidades en incógnito, Candace Cameron Bure es la Dra. Lauren Brunell, que acepta un puesto en Alaska después de perder a su novio y su prestigiosa plaza como cirujana, para aprender cómo es trabajar en un pequeño hospital rural.

programme.title: Mi Hostal Navideño
programme.desc: Jennifer es una ejecutiva cuyos padres deciden pasar la Navidad sin ella, decide dejar San Francisco y visitar el hostal que heredó de su abuela en Alaska para arreglarlo y venderlo.

programme.title: Señor y Señora Adelman
programme.desc: Sarah y Victor llevan juntos más de 45 años. ¿Cómo lo han conseguido? ¿Quién es en realidad Sarah, esa enigmática mujer que ha estado siempre a la sombra de su marido? El amor, la ambición y los secretos alimentan la odisea de esta pareja poco corriente.

programme.title: Algún día nos lo contaremos todo
programme.desc: Verano de 1990, antigua Alemania Oriental. María está a punto de cumplir 19 años y vive en la granja de los padres de su novio Johannes...

programme.title: Borg McEnroe. La película
programme.desc: Wimbledon 1980, el sueco imperturbable Björn Borg y el temperamental norteamericano John McEnroe se enfrentan en una final legendaria que marca la historia del tenis. Dos iconos de este deporte completamente opuestos que se convirtieron en leyenda. Fuego y hielo en la pista. La película que recrea una de las mayores rivalidades deportivas de todos los tiempos.

programme.title: Desayuno en Plutón
programme.desc: Patrick Braden es un joven encantador, pero más duro de lo que aparenta. Abandonado al nacer en un pequeño pueblo irlandés, es…

programme.title: Asesino a sueldo
programme.desc: Viktor creció en los suburbios de Rumanía y conoce el valor de la vida, lo que lo convierte en el asesino perfecto. Después de ser traicionado por aquellos que consideraba sus amigos, debe fingir su propia muerte y huir a Londres, donde se une a una nueva familia de gánsteres.

programme.title: Mea culpa
programme.desc: Simon y Franck son amigos, compañeros y ambos buenos policías. Pero sus vidas se derrumban cuando Simon, conduciendo borracho, provoca un trágico accidente de tráfico. Seis años después, ya fuera de la policía y divorciado de su mujer Alice, Simon se ve obligado actuar cuando su familia está en peligro. El dúo con Franck se recompone, aunque persisten las zonas oscuras de su pasado común.

programme.title: Nowhere
programme.desc: En un país latinoamericano, su dictador ha urdido un siniestro plan.

programme.title: Operación Concha
programme.desc: Un estafador atrae a un inversor contratando a un doble de una estrella de cine.

programme.title: Rivales
programme.desc: Dos equipos juveniles van a la final en Sevilla mientras se entrelazan historias familiares y sociales.

programme.title: Operación Concha
programme.desc: Un estafador atrae a un inversor contratando a un doble de una estrella de cine.

programme.title: Entonces llegaste tú
programme.desc: Una viuda solitaria plantea realizar un viaje alrededor del mundo con las cenizas de su marido para visitar los sitios que ambos adoraban en sus películas favoritas.

programme.title: The Escort
programme.desc: Desesperado por una buena historia, un periodista adicto al sexo se sumerge en el mundo de las señoritas de compañía de lujo cuando comienza a seguirle los pasos a una prostituta licenciada en Stanford.

programme.title: Tyler Perry: Boo! A Madea Halloween
programme.desc: En la noche más espeluznante del año, Madea es convocada para vigilar a la hija adolescente de Brian y evitar que se meta en problemas.

programme.title: El Ascenso
programme.desc: Dos subgerentes de un supermercado corporativo compiten por un ascenso codiciado y no se detendrán ante nada para conseguirlo.

programme.title: Hitch: Especialista en ligues
programme.desc: En esta sofisticada comedia romántica Alex "Hitch" Hitchens (Will Smith) es un legendario (y deliberadamente anónimo) "doctor de citas", que cobra por ayudar a muchos hombres a seducir a las mujeres de sus sueños. Mientras está aconsejando a Albert (Kevin James), un contador sumiso enamorado de la famosa y glamourosa Allegra Cole (la supermodelo Amber Valleta), Hitch encuentra a una rival de su mismo nivel: la fabulosa e ingeniosa Sara Melas (Eva Mendes), una columnista del corazón que sigue todos los movimientos de Allegra. Convertido en un gran soltero profesional, Hitch se enamora extravagantemente de Sara, una reportera cuya mayor primicia podría ser desenmascarar al doctor de citas más famoso de Manhattan.

programme.title: Dos Familias Y Una Boda
programme.desc: Dos familias de clases sociales muy diferentes chocan cuando se reúnen para celebrar una boda.

programme.title: El Hombre De La Casa
programme.desc: Cuando cinco alegres animadoras son testigo del asesinato de un confidente, requieren vigilancia las veinticuatro horas del día para evitar ser las siguientes víctimas. En eso que entra el duro Ranger de Texas, el teniente Roland Sharp (Tommy Lee Jones), que se hace pasar por su segundo entrenador alojándose en el campus universitario. Pero estas enérgicas jovencitas solo quieren salir fiesta y el estirado Sharp aprende que no es un trabajo fácil mantener fuera de peligro a estas incontrolables estudiantes. Cedric the Entertainer se une a este fogoso reparto en una comedia llena de energía, orgullo y la alegría de un Ranger de Texas que se pone en contacto con su lado femenino.

programme.title: Escuela De Genios
programme.desc: Tres brillantes universitarios trabajan en un proyecto de laboratorio pero tienen tiempo para divertirse y convertir la residencia en una pista de patinaje sobre hielo, desmontar y montar el coche de un compañero u organizar una fiesta playera en pleno auditórium. Cuando el trío descubre que el profesor Hathaway les ha tenido trabajando en un arma secreta para el ejército, deciden tramar un plan de venganza que dejará boquiabiertos a los militares.

programme.title: Dónde diablos está el oro
programme.desc: En 1895, los forajidos Cross y Boone se ven obligados a llevar a las autoridades mexicanas su botín. Viajan hasta allí en un tren lleno de dinamita con un grupo de prostitutas. Los rebeldes mexicanos, los indios y los agentes de la Wells Fargo les persiguen.

programme.title: La venganza de los cheyennes
programme.desc: Cuando Charlotte Sutter es secuestrada por los apaches, su hermano Sam, ayudado por un viejo buscador borracho, va en su busca.

programme.title: Perseguido
programme.desc: Huérfano tras el asesinato de su familia, Jeb es criado en un rancho, pero su pasado lo persigue. Enamorado de su hermana adoptiva y enfrentado a su hermano, también es acechado por un misterioso tío que busca venganza. A pesar de convertirse en héroe de guerra, Jeb lucha contra enemigos ocultos y un destino trágico en el salvaje Oeste.

programme.title: Tormenta en Arizona
programme.desc: Película de vaqueros publicada en 1956 dirigida por Joseph Kane y protagonizada por Skip Homeier: Tomenta en Arizona - Se descubre una rica veta de mineral en una mina de plata cerca de un pequeño pueblo. El corrupto alcalde casi consigue hacerse con el control de la mina.

programme.title: Entre Dios, el diablo y un arma
programme.desc: Un hombre accede al mapa de un tesoro y convence a un guía (Juan Chasquisdo) para que le acompañe en su búsqueda para recuperarlo. Ambos son perseguidos por bandidos.

programme.title: Toque de Queda
programme.desc: Es una película guatemalteca que narra cómo los vecinos de Villas de la Esperanza, acechados por la eventual invasión de violentos, deciden armarse y patrullar de noche, dispuestos a defender con su vida sus hogares y familias.

programme.title: El hombre del presidente 2
programme.desc: El presidente asigna a un especialista en contraterrorismo la tarea de localizar a un terrorista sospechoso de planear la activación de un dispositivo nuclear en Estados Unidos.

programme.title: Un Año y algo más
programme.desc: Un reparto de lujo encabeza esta historia aclamada por la crítica sobre un joven que, tras caerse de un tejado en una fiesta de Año Nuevo, decide que es hora de hacer algunos cambios en su vida, como reencontrarse con su hijo y enamorarse.

programme.title: El engaño
programme.desc: El policía Mike Santini vive y trabaja en Nueva York. Él y su familia están de vacaciones en el Caribe cuando descubre al criminal fugitivo Eddie Meyers. Santini detiene a Meyers.

programme.title: 3 generaciones
programme.desc: Regan (Elle Fanning) es una adolescente de Nueva York que decide operarse para cambiar de sexo. Junto a su madre, Maggie (Naomi Watts), viven en casa de su abuela, Dolly (Susan Sarandon), una manager de música que comparte piso con su novia. Maggie tiene que enfrentarse al padre de Regan para que firme también los permisos de la operación y deberá asumir que tiene que criar a su única hija como un hijo.

programme.title: Urban Hymn
programme.desc: Durante los disturbios ocurridos en Reino Unido en 2011, Jamie, una adolescente problemática, deberá decidir su futuro. Puede dejarse llevar por su mejor amiga, una chica posesiva y destructiva o hacer caso a su asistente social, una mujer convencida del talento musical de la joven.

programme.title: Exorcismo en Georgia
programme.desc: Poco después de trasladarse a su nueva casa en Georgia una pareja se entera de que su hija tiene misteriosas visiones de personas que nadie más que ella parece ver. Finalmente ellos también son testigos de extraños fenómenos que tienen lugar alrededor de la casa y que van aportando pistas de lo que podría ser un escalofriante misterio que se ha mantenido en secreto durante generaciones.

programme.title: Aprendiz de gigoló
programme.desc: Dos amigos judíos de edad avanzada (Allen y Turturro) se encuentran ante una desesperada situación financiera. Deciden entonces probar suerte con el negocio de la prostitución masculina, uno como gigoló y el otro como "representante". Pero el asunto no será bien visto en la comunidad judía en la que viven.

programme.title: ¡Ni te me acerques!
programme.desc: Él solo tenía que cuidar el hotel y teclear su novela, como Jack Nicholson en “El Resplandor”, pero de buen rollo.

programme.title: Benidorm mon amour
programme.desc: Tonet aprovecha un permiso de la mili para ir en coche con sus amigos Sento, Jaume y Tomy a Benidorm. Sueñan con disfrutar unos días del sol, las playas y, sobre todo, de las suecas y sus biquinis.

programme.title: El Lute II: mañana seré libre
programme.desc: Eleuterio se escapa de la cárcel, se une a sus hijos y emprende un viaje con su familia evitando la cacería de la Guardia Civil.

programme.title: Carmen
programme.desc: La naturaleza libre y enigmática de una mujer llamada Carmen, su belleza meridional, su carácter arrebatado y pasional, hacen que el sargento José se convierta en víctima y protagonista de acontecimientos extraordinarios.

programme.title: Sons of Liberty
programme.desc: An elite team of scientists and soldiers unite to thwart a terrorist plot to detonate a nuclear weapon along the Gulf Coast.

programme.desc: Un grupo formado por una elfa, un hombre y un orco emprenderán una aventura para evitar que una orden secreta lleve al mundo de Saga a la oscuridad.

programme.title: Thor: god of thunder (esp)
programme.desc: Loki, el malvado tío de Thor, ha escapado de Asgard en busca de Yggdrasil, el Árbol de los Nueve Reinos, un árbol que contiene el poder del universo y que está oculto en la Tierra.

programme.title: Arenas movedizas
programme.desc: En este thriller negro, un banquero de carácter introvertido y trabajador se ve envuelto en una serie de eventos que incluyen un asesinato y una trama de chantaje, todo mientras intenta mantener su vida en orden.

programme.title: Blackjack
programme.desc: Dolph Lundgren interpreta a Jack Devlin, un U.S Marshal que protege a clientes de alto perfil cuando se trata de una cuestión de seguridad.

programme.title: Speed Asesino
programme.desc: Dos mejores amigos utilizan aviones de alta tecnología construidos por ellos mismos para llevar droga de México a California y financiar así su estilo de vida en Hollywood.

programme.title: Blind man
programme.desc: Comienza con el descubrimiento de un cadáver. Un solitario policía sospecha rápidamente de un hombre ciego, cuya minusvalía le resulta una ventaja. Empieza así una carrera contrarreloj y un duelo a muerte entre dos hombres a cuál más enigmático.

programme.title: Furia
programme.desc: Lee Gunner, un veterano de guerra se ve obligado a regresar a un mundo de violencia y desesperación cuando sus hijos son secuestrados por una peligrosa banda de narcotraficantes.

programme.title: El justiciero
programme.desc: Paul Kersey (Bruce Willis) es un famoso cirujano que vive felizmente con su familia en Chicago. Un día, su esposa (Elisabeth Shue) y su hija (Camila Morrone) son brutalmente atacadas en su casa. Paul, que siempre había sido un tipo tranquilo, siente cómo la sed de venganza va apoderándose de él...

programme.title: El tren de las 3:10
